title: Path picker badge series
summary: Adds a backend-owned, allowlisted path-picker browse command and a reusable WebView badge helper, then places compact badges beside real operator path fields across Launch, Reports, Metrics, Rename source staging, Settings, Library Profiles, Final Library Promotion rules, Subtitle OCR paths, and Network path-map prefixes.
reason: Operators need a consistent way to browse Windows files/folders for path fields without each frontend surface inventing filesystem behavior or bypassing backend command ownership.
behavior_before: Only a few surfaces had bespoke full-size browse buttons. Many real path fields required manual typing, and there was no shared allowlisted path-picker command for staged-only picker results.
behavior_after: Allowlisted path fields can open the backend Windows picker through POST /api/path-picker/browse. Picker responses stage selected values into the relevant field only, report validation evidence, and do not save settings, launch work, scan folders, mutate queues, rename, publish, delete, or touch media files.
